brief.summary_1line: After his coronation, Rama respectfully bids farewell to allied kings and relatives who return to their own realms with gifts and honor.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama rises from his throne and embraces the King of Kashi in a long farewell before sending him back to his walled city of Benares.
In the royal court of Ayodhya, Rama with folded palms respectfully addresses King Janaka while offering him jewels before his departure.
Lakshmana escorts Yudajit as he departs from Ayodhya, compared to Vishnu following Indra after the slaying of Vritra.
